title: Board LODs, Grid Snap, and SVG Icons
description: Board: four discrete LODs (minimap/overview/normal/detail) with configurable zoom thresholds as props; per-LOD grid (none / 10 / 10+5 / 10+5+1), node stroke/fill, edge weight, handles, labels vs abbreviated vs vello_svg icons; grid snap to visible grid lines with toolbar toggle; integrate vello_svg for detail node icons from metabolism example SVGs.
summary: Implemented explicit per-LOD board interaction mechanisms across the TS renderer and Rust host. Minimap now disables individual picks and drag while preserving area selection; overview uses indirect handle rings and two-step indirect target selection; normal exposes direct handle linking and rendering; detail and micro keep handle selection with proximity-capable link targeting. The TS overlay path now derives node and handle captions from kind catalogs so detail can show abbreviated handle labels and node-kind fallbacks. Verified with the focused Vitest board suite and the full Rust board crate tests.
